Every execution still re-enters dispatch(), so interactive and scriptable paths share one pipeline (CLI-03).
PHASE2-PTY-OPERATOR.authorized_gate_change: test_exit_returns_zero blocked on proc.wait() without draining the terminal, filling the PTY buffer and stopping the child mid-write so it never reached its exit path. Proven a harness artifact by probe: identical keystrokes return 0 the instant draining resumes. Changed to drain while polling within the same 8s bound; the assertion (exit code 0 from real keystrokes) is unchanged. User-authorized 2026-08-01.
